sin.name: go-poetic-type-name
sin.description: A class is named by a word that does not say what it is, alone or as a part of its name: Said, Worded, ReportMadeCard, HeldLine, Watching.
sin.rule: Name a class for what it holds or does, in an ordinary word: a line with its values is a Nudge, a snapshot of the options is Settings.
